items.label: Size Fits Your Dogs
items.value: The internal size of this dog furniture crate 24.8"L x 16.9"W x 20.9"H suitable for small dog breeds such as Chihuahua, Pug, Pomeranian and Poodle

items.label: Decorative Pet Cage
items.value: This is more than just a dog kennel indoor, it can also be used as a TV stand, coffee table or side table in the living room. In the bedroom, it can be used as a nightstand or placed at the foot of the bed

items.label: 3-Door Design
items.value: Our dog crates feature a 3-door design that allows for easy access from the front and sides for your furry friend

items.label: Anti-Chew & Anti-Escape
items.value: We know how important it is to keep your pets comfortable. We use 0.4 inch heavy duty iron pipe, double welding points and thickened engineered wood, and each door has 2 locks to provide multiple layers of protection to reduce your dog from escape!

items.label: Unique Arch Door
items.value: Our furniture dog crate adopts a novel arch design, which blends in with many modern furniture styles. The and elegant style of the arch creates a clean, tidy and comfortable living environment for you
